title: Dokimon Quest
provenance: Reported by udance4ever (highball-db#344, 2026-10-05), Apple M1, macOS 27.0.1, Highball 0.10.8, engine x64-sikarugir10.0_6-r21, D3DMetal, rated 4 of 5 after 5 minutes. Not verified by the maintainer.
notes: Reported playable on D3DMetal. Four error boxes come up before the game starts, and pressing OK on each lets it start and play normally. No measurement here yet.

knownIssues.symptom: Four boxes saying 'Win32 function failed: HRESULT 0x80070057' from GR_D3D_Device->CheckMultisampleQualityLevels before the game starts
knownIssues.cause: The game is made with GameMaker, whose runner shows every failed graphics query in a box. Asked for 8 or more samples, D3DMetal answers Direct3D 11's multisample quality query with E_INVALIDARG, where Windows, DXMT and DXVK answer success with zero quality levels (measured on an M4 with engine r21, 2026-10-05)
knownIssues.fix: Press OK on each box and the game starts and plays. Setting the game to DXMT should skip the boxes, since DXMT answers the query the Windows way; not yet tried with this game (highball-db#344)
